narrative.overview: Scope: pieces/019-city-of-signs/ only. Interchangeable architectural blocks create a dense black-and-white city with unequal chambers and improbable rooftops. The user-approved geometric AI image established visual direction; the shipped artwork is procedural Canvas geometry. thumbnail.jpg is a square screenshot of the renderer at seed 1907, not an AI raster used as code. Independent review disposition: Ship for square, desktop, mobile, and catalog, with no blocking findings.
keyCharacteristics: 26 blocks: 6 ground-only bases, 12 chambers, 6 crowns, 2 connectors
5–22 unequal bays recomposed for the viewport
Unframed variable-height geometry with guaranteed fan, folding-stair, and swelling-wall features
Immediate regeneration through click, tap, Enter, or Space
No text or pictorial illustrations in the normal canvas

rules.name: Cutout depth
rules.body: Use overlap, apertures, polarity, and scale without shadows or gradients.

dos: Do preserve ground-only bases and viewport-specific composition.
Do keep block drawing functions reusable across dimensions and polarity.
Do capture shipping thumbnails from the renderer with recorded seed and framing.
donts: Don't add room frames, uniform rounded geometry, or a gray drawing palette.
Don't substitute the approved reference raster for procedural geometry.
Don't impose this artwork's design system on other HyperGal pieces.
